1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. Through the present petition, the petitioner seeks quashing of the FIR bearing no. 140/2024 registered at Police Station - Nabi Karim for the offences punishable under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

Learned APP for State, who appears on advance notice, accepts notice and seeks some time to file status report.
5. Let the same be filed three days prior to the next date of hearing.
6. List on 23.01.2026.
